# Introduction

Use the probability rules from the reading to answer the questions below. For discrete events, probabilities range from 0 to 1, all possible outcomes have probabilities that add to 1, and the probability of an event not occurring is its complement. For continuous distributions, probability is represented by area under the curve.

# Discrete Events
